section.title: Overview
section.prose:
A component is the single document class of the specification corpus: a versioned root element carrying a required status and an ordered list of blocks. This file is itself a component describing the vocabulary, so it exercises every block type. The block taxonomy is seeded from a proven manual chapter shape and Lean-style titled boxes
.

Each
defines its terms once and references them thereafter; the validator enforces define-once and resolution across the whole corpus. The
attribute is required.

section.title: Block types
section.definition: A paragraph of inline content: literal text, inline math such as tilde(mu) , term references, and cite references.

grammar.production: section | prose | judgements | grammar | rule | definition | diagram | code | example | references

diagram.caption: A component contains sections, which contain blocks.

section.diagram: #diagram( node((0,0), [component]), node((1,0), [section]), node((1,1), [block]), edge((0,0), (1,0), [contains], "->"), edge((1,0), (1,1), [contains], "->"), edge((0,0), (1,1), [reaches], "-->"), )

example.title: A code block anticipating output
example.prose: Code blocks structurally anticipate checked examples. The tool validates the shape of the expectation but never executes it.
